method: Recompute both existing formulas on each actual recorded selection candidate set at the last original reprice scored_at timestamp.
Preserve actual priority of initial/fresh candidates with snapshot=null; rank by descending priority and original enqueue token for ties.
Join timing and scheduler monotonic clocks using their saved origins; sum only successful chat usage for known tokens.
Queue-choice differences hold all observed histories and candidate membership fixed; no synthetic future actions, scores, admission times, or saved GPU are inferred.
limitations: One fixed A→B pair with stochastic trajectories; different early paths exist before each game first requeues.
Slot-held durations include CPU/local work and are not GPU kernel time; known tokens omit failed/partial server generations.
Original completed public traces are selected outcomes, not hidden-generalization evidence.
